summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing web font rendering strategy selection (FOUT vs FOIT) at the page_load stage. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills: Next.js Font Loading Optimization (session_skill, build_and_deployment stage, framework-specific), Link Prefetching Strategy (navigation stage, unrelated domain), or peer candidates (bfcache, post-load CLS diagnosis, font fallback metrics). The candidate fills a gap in font rendering strategy decision-making and is supported by evidence on layout shift causes. No conflicts detected.
